title: Immersive
description: This Modpack is fully client side, it adds so much mods to make minecraft more immersive, and it also include fps optimizations mods.
body:
# Enhanced Minecraft Experience

**A lightweight client-side modpack focused on improving Minecraft visuals, animations, atmosphere, and performance.**

### Features

**Enhanced animations**

**Improved visual effects**

**Better world atmosphere**

**FPS optimization mods**

**Multiplayer compatibility**

**Quality-of-life improvements**

## Performance
**Vanilla Minecraft: ~400–600 FPS**

**With this modpack + shaders: ~80–130 FPS**

### About

**This modpack is designed for players who want a smoother and more immersive Minecraft experience without heavily impacting performance.**
